outcome: Control verbs tell the truth about why nothing happened: a takeover during an unexpired owner lease returns a named wait signal with the remaining lease time instead of a silent status dump, and the board's takeover hint derives from the actual admission conditions - so the operator's next command is informed, not guessed.

exclude: changing takeover admission itself (when a takeover is legal is untouched)

acceptance.text: Takeover while the owner lease is live returns a named owner-transition signal carrying the lease expiry, mirroring the existing Resume branch: pinned by a runtime control fixture on the OWNER_ACTIVE path.
The CLI renders that signal as an actionable message naming the wait, exiting nonzero rather than printing a success-shaped status: pinned by a cmd/sworn fixture.
The board's takeover hint appears only when the journal's takeover conditions actually hold: pinned by a presentation fixture where a dead-but-unexpired owner shows the wait, not the hint.

constraints: No admission rule changes; this slice only stops a refusal from wearing a success costume.

Evidence basis: the OWNER_ACTIVE switch returns a plain status for takeover (internal/runtime/service.go:1137-1146), the CLI prints it with exit 0, and the board advertises takeover the journal will reject (internal/runtime/status.go:277, internal/cockpit/presentation.go:75-78) - two failed attempts and a wrong hypothesis before the real cause was found (sworn#193).
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.
